summary: Yimutian Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Beijing-based Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting completion of three share-funded acquisitions: control of 100% of Qingdao Xingongguan for US$5.8 million, certain Zhaodong Guohe land, buildings and equipment for US$21,161,390, and a first-phase 33.33% equity interest in Qingdao Quanao from Aoge for US$25 million, all via Class A ordinary share issuance completed September 10-20, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. The company states the closings restore stockholders' equity above the Nasdaq Rule 5550(b)(1) $2.5 million minimum, pending Nasdaq confirmation. Watch dilution from the share issuance and Nasdaq compliance confirmation risk.
